(a) This part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issue of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for small airplanes in the normal, utility, and acrobatic categories.
(b) Each person who applies under Part 21 [New] for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements of this part.

[(a) This Part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issue of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for small airplanes in the normal, utility, and acrobatic categories that have a passenger seating configuration, excluding pilot seats, of nine seats or less.]
(b) Each person who applies under Part 21 for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements of this Part.

[(a) This Part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issue of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for airplanes in the normal, utility, acrobatic and commuter categories.]
(b) Each person who applies under Part 21 for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements of this Part.
